'''Isttu Village''' was a small settlement located on the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']].

The village mostly surrounded a large lake, which provided lush greenery in the local area, allowing the settlers to farm for crops.
